Compared the old _evidence with the new one in git diff 9593869..HEAD: every previous top-level and per-account key is kept. The only changes add fields: statement, period, format, input_sha256, vat_stagger, money_in, thresholds, indicators, judgement_queue, lines[].reverses, overrides, the hashes, memo, model, and policy_check.hidden/policy. schema_version is still EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION (src/cma/models.py:73). graph.py is untouched, and test_cma_run_evidence_keeps_todays_keys pins cma run's exact key set and PASSED in contracts-4.log. Packs signed before this change (two files) still complete, because _complete checks the hashes in the case log, not PACK_FILES (src/cma/pack.py:834-841).

monthly_csv neutralises the account, month, note and line-id cells (src/cma/pack.py:691-697). Account keys cannot begin with a formula character (src/cma/store.py:64, [a-z0-9] first). Line-id cells are JSON lists that begin with '['. The header and the yes/no and ISO date columns are fixed text. Value columns are numbers formatted to the penny, with -0.00 written as 0.00. A negative balance such as -46.55 begins with '-', but it is a numeric cell, which I read as outside P8's 'text cell'. test_p8_monthly_csv_text_cells_never_begin_with_a_formula_character ran 3 times with hostile ids such as =HYPERLINK(1) and PASSED in invariants-5.log.

findings.claim: sign_off reads firm.yaml a second time (firm.load()) to record egress.offline_lock, while show_policy_verdict and the snapshot come from the reading _build took. One sign-off can therefore record two different readings of firm.yaml, and the offline flag in the evidence may not be the one from the reading that decided the pack.
findings.repro: Patch firm.load so the second call returns offline_lock: false while the first (inside _build) returns the default. Sign off a case: evidence.egress.offline_lock is false although the preview's reading had the lock on. Passing the config _build read into _evidence would fix it.
